GroundTruth requires eval entitlement (C3), separate from ops RBAC. Alertmanager webhooks: /webhooks/alerts/alertmanager (F1–F5).

schema.title: Response List Ground Truth Eval Ground Truth Get

post.description:
I6 eval/test harness — real ApprovalDecision + workflow signal.

Requires ``eval_entitled`` (ops Responder alone is not enough). Uses the
domain decide command (same rows as human decide) and signals
``approval_decision`` so ``wait_for_approval`` resumes.

Accept an Alertmanager webhook payload.

Auth: Bearer / Basic / custom header (see docs/alert-webhooks.md).
Replay: ``Idempotency-Key`` or ``X-Request-Id``, else SHA-256 of body.
Duplicate keys return **200** with ``status=duplicate`` (success/no-op).
F2/F4: normalize, upsert alert, correlate by fingerprint/time/service.
F5: after commit, idempotently start IncidentWorkflow → INVESTIGATING.
